visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed image + heading + single CTA. Edge-to-edge, viewport-height background image; heading and one CTA stacked and centred near the bottom (dark image / light text).
contentPattern: Row 1: image (hero banner, desktop 1920) + alt. Row 2: richtext with heading (h1/h2, e.g. 'MG SELECT x GAURAV GUPTA') and one CTA link (e.g. 'EXPLORE' to /brand-collaboration/mg-select-x-gaurav-gupta).
